articles.title: White House adviser defends President Trump's crypto ties in wake of Clarity Act defeat
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump's crypto adviser, Patrick Witt, accused Democrats of unfairly amplifying Trump's crypto ties as a political weapon.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: Inside the chain settling $150 billion of stablecoins a week
articles.snippet: Tron launched as a content-distribution project and has become the settlement layer for a large share of the world's USDT, processing roughly $150 billion to $190 billion of stablecoin transfers a week. Josh Olszewicz of Canary Capital breaks down how the network's economics work and what stablecoin regulation could do to the thesis.

articles.title: Bitcoin's $16 billion quarterly options settlement arrives with a 'call-heavy' book
articles.snippet: Nearly $18 billion in bitcoin and ether options will expire on Friday, potentially reshaping dealer hedging flows and short-term volatility.
